newsitem.title: CHINA: S.Korean, Italian firms win big China gas contracts.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean, Italian firms win big China gas contracts.

text.p: Hyundai Heavy Industry of South Korea and an Italian firm have won contracts worth $300 million to provide a gas platform and two pipelines for the Pinghu gas field south of Shanghai, an oil industry official said on Monday.
Hyundai would provide a gas platform worth $100 million which would include production facilities and apartments for oil workers, the Shanghai Oil & Gas Company official said.

The Italian firm will provide two undersea pipelines worth $200 million, one of which will run for 375 km and bring 1.2 million cubic metres of natural gas a day from the field to residential and industrial consumers in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, he said.
He did not give the full name of the Italian company.
The second pipeline will run 305 km from the gas field to an oil terminal in the Zhoushan islands in Zhejiang province where it will be processed into petrochemical products, he said.
